_doc: Date-ranged seasons. start/end are MM-DD (inclusive) and repeat every year. Each theme: key, name, short, queries (Wikimedia Commons search terms), match (regex that a photo's title, categories or description must hit), prompts (scene ideas for the AI imposter). Add a season or a theme here; nothing else needs to change.
